blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp., the hospitality subsidiary of Philippine property developer DoubleDragon Corp., is expanding into Malaysia with the development of a 606-room hotel in Johor Bahru. The Nasdaq-listed company signed definitive binding agreements Friday to build Hotel101-Johor Bahru, which is projected to become the city’s largest hotel by room inventory. READ: Hotel101 […]...
